contract: Read AC-3 main-body syncframes through all six blocks under the A/52:2018 high-exponent, minimum-SNR profile. An independent wire reader checks exponent strategies, bit allocation side information and the zero-width mantissa domain.
Compare one kind 4 row per syncframe: byte offset and the 16 FrameFeatures flags in declaration order.

The controls vary early and late block flags, coupling, phase words, rematrixing, delta allocation, dynamic range, dither and reuse across blocks. General bit allocation and Annex E tool usage remain outside this contract.
